The '''TI-84 Plus CE series''' is a line of [[graphing calculator]]s manufactured by [[Texas Instruments]] (TI). The original TI-84 Plus CE superseded the [[TI-84 Plus series]] upon its introduction in 2015; together with the [[TI-Nspire series]], the TI-84 Plus CE is the previous generation flagship series of Texas Instruments graphing calculators.

In 2020, TI Education announced its decision to remove support for [[Assembly language|assembly]] and [[C (programming language)|C programming]] on these calculators in response to a video posted on YouTube detailing how to bypass the test mode on OS version 5.2.2. Texas Instruments' response was widely considered unnecessary and led to anger from users.<ref name="Hackster" /> The changes are reflected in OS version 5.5.1 for the European models and OS version 5.5.5 for the US models.

==Editions==
=== TI-84 Plus CE ===
The TI-84 Plus CE (known as the TI-83 Premium CE in France) was publicly previewed by Texas Instruments in January 2015,<ref>{{cite web |title=TI-84 Plus CE Graphing Calculator by Texas Instruments |url=http://education.ti.com/en/us/promotions/84ce-preview-page/overview |access-date=13 January 2015 |publisher=TI Education |archive-date=2015-01-14  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150114061119/http://education.ti.com/en/us/promotions/84ce-preview-page/overview |url-status=live }}</ref> and released later that year.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=TI-84 Plus CE |url=http://www.datamath.org/Graphing/TI-84PLUS_CE.htm |access-date=2025-11-11 |website=www.datamath.org |publisher=Datamath Calculator Museum |archive-date=2025-09-07  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250907201236/http://www.datamath.org/Graphing/TI-84PLUS_CE.htm |url-status=live }}</ref>

Technologically, it is a significant improvement over the [[TI-84 Plus C Silver Edition]] (CSE); it retains the 320×240-pixel color screen, rechargeable battery, and key layout of the CSE, while removing the 2.5&nbsp;mm "I/O" [[serial port]]. The CE also had six times the memory and was thrice as fast as its predecessor.<ref name=":0" />

In addition, the RSA signing key length has been increased to 2048 bits, making infeasible previous efforts to unlock the calculator to unrestricted third-party software development.{{citation needed|date=September 2025}} The calculator has 154&nbsp;KB of user-accessible RAM and 3.0&nbsp;MB of Archive memory. It uses the [[eZ80]] processor from Zilog, which maintained "binary compatibility" with programs written for the older [[Zilog Z80|Z80]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=DATAMATH |url=http://www.datamath.org/GraphArchitecture.htm#eZ80 |access-date=2025-11-11 |website=www.datamath.org}}</ref>

The CE was introduced in multiple colors (Classic (black), Silver Linings, Radical Red, True Blue, Denim (navy blue), Lightning (light blue), Plum Pi (purple); Positively Pink (as of March 2015), Golden Ratio, and Bright White (as of June 2016) were added later), and further colors have since been released.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 February 2025 |title=All of the Ti-84 Plus CE Colors Ever Made |url=https://underwooddistributing.com/blogs/calculators/all-ti-84-plus-ce-colors |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250717214007/https://underwooddistributing.com/blogs/calculators/all-ti-84-plus-ce-colors |archive-date=17 July 2025 |access-date=10 November 2025 |website=Underwood Distributing Co.}}</ref> Like the rest of the TI-84 Plus series, certain countries permit its use in examinations.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cemetech.net/tools/ti84pce |title=Get Started with the TI-84 Plus CE |publisher=Cemetech |access-date=13 April 2016 |archive-date=2025-09-21  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250921031947/https://www.cemetech.net/tools/ti84pce |url-status=live }}</ref>

The calculator comes programmed with seven different languages ([[English language|English]], [[French language|French]], [[German language|German]], [[Dutch language|Dutch]], [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]], [[Spanish language|Spanish]], and [[Swedish language|Swedish]]).{{citation needed|date=September 2025}}

=== TI-84 Plus CE-T ===
In 2016, the '''TI-84 Plus CE-T''' was released for the European educational market. The only significant difference from the CE model is the addition of an [[Light-emitting diode|LED]] that blinks while the calculator is in Press-to-Test mode.{{citation needed|date=September 2025}}

Hardware revisions M and later (which were manufactured starting May 2019) have a revamped [[Printed circuit board|PCB]],<ref>codename SG95, see {{Cite web |title=TI graphing calculators (+ accessories) revisions with motherboard(s) codename(s) and label(s) |url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1N_2tBusqjVzefKb4impi-VwdM-RgOSIMmXBemJymxA0/edit#gid=0&range=B531}}</ref><ref>PCB photo showing the new architecture {{Cite web |title=TI-84 Plus CE-T; HW Rev M (PCB) |url=https://tiplanet.org/forum/gallery/image_page.php?image_id=11485 |access-date=2025-09-02  |archive-date=2024-12-24  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241224193632/https://tiplanet.org/forum/gallery/image_page.php?image_id=11485 |url-status=live }}</ref> improved [[Computer architecture|architecture]], and a new [[Flash memory|flash chip]].<ref>codenames SG92 and SG93, see {{Cite web |title=TI graphing calculators (+ accessories) revisions with motherboard(s) codename(s) and label(s) |url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1N_2tBusqjVzefKb4impi-VwdM-RgOSIMmXBemJymxA0/edit#gid=0&range=B531 |access-date=2025-09-02  |archive-date=2025-05-27  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250527230922/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1N_2tBusqjVzefKb4impi-VwdM-RgOSIMmXBemJymxA0/edit#gid=0&range=B531 |url-status=live }}</ref> Due to this change, these more recent revisions have seen a significant improvement in overall speed.{{citation needed|date=September 2025}}

=== TI-84 Plus CE Python ===
The '''TI-84 Plus CE-T Python''' was released in 2021 and provides OS version 5.6 and above with the ability to program the calculator in [[Python (programming language)|Python]] and includes a preloaded bundle of applications.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://education.ti.com/en-gb/products/calculators/graphing-calculators/ti-84-plus-ce-t-python |title=TI-84 Plus CE-T Python Edition graphing calculator |access-date=2025-09-02  |archive-date=2023-02-09  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230209004209/https://education.ti.com/en-gb/products/calculators/graphing-calculators/ti-84-plus-ce-t-python |url-status=live }}</ref> The Python implementation is extremely slow compared to [[NumWorks]] and [[Hewlett-Packard|HP]] calculators due to the use of an ARM coprocessor running [[CircuitPython]], which communicates to the calculator via 115200 baud UART serial.<ref>{{Cite web |author-last=Heckendorn |author-first=Ben |date=2022-03-09 |title=Inside the TI 84 Python Calculator! |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DXvJ8duZqdA |website=YouTube |access-date=2025-09-02  |archive-date=2025-06-04  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250604202728/https://www.youtube.com/watch?pp=ygUVcG9rZW1vbiB0aSA4NCBwbHVzIGNl&v=DXvJ8duZqdA |url-status=live }}</ref> In the North American market, the '''TI-84 Plus CE Python''' replaced the existing TI-84 Plus CE in 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/graphing-calculators/ti-84-plus-ce-python |title=TI-84 Plus CE Python&#124; Graphing Calculator&#124; Texas Instruments |access-date=2025-09-02  |archive-date=2025-08-31  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250831015231/https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/graphing-calculators/ti-84-plus-ce-python |url-status=live }}</ref>

Around 2021, Texas Instruments removed the charging light (notably on the black model).{{Citation needed|date=August 2024}}
In 2026, Texas Instruments discontinued the TI 84 CE Python, and moved all Python coding to the TI 84 Evo. <ref>[https://underwooddistributing.com/blogs/calculators/ti-84-plus-ce-python-update] </ref>
=== TI-84 Plus CE EZ-Spot ===
The '''TI-84 Plus CE EZ-Spot series''', also known as the '''School editions''' and the '''School Property editions''', are variants of TI-84 Plus CE series calculators produced by Texas Instruments and only made available for schools to purchase. This special yellow-tinted design was produced in an effort to combat theft.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Products by Texas Instruments - Eastern Europe |url=https://education.ti.com/eu/products |access-date=2025-04-19 |website=education.ti.com |language=eu}}</ref> Owners can buy other interchangeable colored slide-cases online. Only the TI-84 Plus CE and TI-84 Plus CE Python have had a School Property variant, and not the regional models like the TI-83 Premium CE or TI-84 Plus CE-T (regardless of Python).

=== TI-84 Evo ===
The '''TI-84 Evo''' was released in April 2026, after previously having been leaked via online retailers in January of that year.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Thorp-Lancaster |first1=Dan |title=Behold! The latest Texas Instruments graphing calculator is the TI-84 Evo |url=https://tech.yahoo.com/general/article/behold-the-latest-texas-instruments-graphing-calculator-is-the-ti-84-evo-152703186.html |access-date=26 August 2026 |work=Yahoo Tech |date=29 April 2026}}</ref> The device includes USB-C charging (a first for the TI-8x lineup), and a new processor that is three times faster than the one in the TI-84 Plus CE.<ref>{{cite press release |title=Texas Instruments launches the TI-84 Evo Graphing Calculator -- the most advanced TI-84 ever built |url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/texas-instruments-launches-the-ti-84-evo-graphing-calculator--the-most-advanced-ti-84-ever-built-302755962.html |access-date=26 August 2026 |work=Texas Instruments Education Technology |via=PR Newswire |date=28 April 2026 |language=en}}</ref> Unlike the TI-84 Plus CE Python, which used a [[Zilog eZ80]]-based processor with an Arm Cortex M0 co-processor to support CircuitPython, the Evo is built around a single 156Mhz Arm Cortex CPU with native CircuitPython support.<ref>{{cite web |title=The TI-84 Evo graphing calculator |url=https://blog.adafruit.com/2026/05/04/the-ti-84-evo-graphing-calculator/ |publisher=Adafruit |access-date=26 August 2026 |date=4 May 2026}}</ref> The software has been updated to allow using the full screen for graphing, increasing the graphing area by 50%, but graphing speed appears to be artificially software limited to emulate the behavior of previous devices.<ref>{{cite web |last1=E |first1=Travis |title=TI Introduces the TI-84 Evo - ticalc.org |url=https://www.ticalc.org/archives/news/articles/14/149/149507.html |website=www.ticalc.org |access-date=26 August 2026}}</ref> The keyboard is a simplified version of that in previous calculators, and there is a new home screen with icons for various functions that were previously accessed through dedicated buttons (similar to the NumWorks graphing calculator, [[Casio graphic calculators#Third generation|Casio fx-CG series]], and Texas Instruments' own [[TI-Nspire series|TI-Nspire CX II]]).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Introducing the TI-84 Evo {{!}} News {{!}} Cemetech |url=https://www.cemetech.net/news/2026/1/1057/_/introducing-the-ti-84-evo |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=www.cemetech.net}}</ref>

==Software==

=== Programs and applications ===
The TI-84 Plus CE can run a wide variety of both official and community-made software,<ref>{{Cite web |title=TI-83/84 Plus Files (not including the TI-84 Plus C Silver Edition/CE) - ticalc.org |url=https://www.ticalc.org/pub/83plus/ |access-date=2025-09-02 |website=www.ticalc.org |archive-date=2025-08-27  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250827032251/https://www.ticalc.org/pub/83plus/ |url-status=live }}</ref> including video games, math programs, educational programs, graphics programs, and even some internet-based programs (operating through the link port). Applications, often called ''flash applications'', are a type of program stored in the calculator's ROM. Applications tend to be more complex than programs.{{citation needed|date=September 2025}}

The TI-84 Plus CE supports TI-BASIC, eZ80 [[assembly language]] and [[C programming language|C]] (with external tools and software); the [[Python (programming language)|Python]] version of the TI-84 Plus CE supports Python. The calculator can be connected to a USB keyboard to help with programming. TI-84 Plus CE models running operating systems newer than OS 5.6 can no longer run eZ80 assembly or C programs.{{citation needed|date=September 2025}}

Controversially, assembly and C support was removed in OS 5.5.5, released in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TI-84 Plus CE Operating System - Texas Instruments - US and Canada |url=https://education.ti.com/en/software/details/en/158B7669E4C0493A84D33D9A22FDBD3C/ti-84plusceoperatingsystem |access-date=2025-09-02 |website=education.ti.com |archive-date=2025-09-09  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250909065612/https://education.ti.com/en/software/details/en/158B7669E4C0493A84D33D9A22FDBD3C/ti-84plusceoperatingsystem |url-status=live }}</ref> Texas Instruments stated that this change was made to "prioritize learning for students" and to reduce the risk of cheating in examinations.<ref name="Hackster">{{Cite web |title=Texas Instruments Under Fire for Removing ASM, C Programming Features From TI-83, TI-84 Calculators |url=https://www.hackster.io/news/texas-instruments-under-fire-for-removing-asm-c-programming-features-from-ti-83-ti-84-calculators-ba55bdcb0547 |access-date=2025-09-02 |website=Hackster.io |language=en |archive-date=2025-05-31  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250531165357/https://www.hackster.io/news/texas-instruments-under-fire-for-removing-asm-c-programming-features-from-ti-83-ti-84-calculators-ba55bdcb0547 |url-status=live }}</ref> In addition to this, they blocked the ability to downgrade to any version below OS 5.5.5 to make sure that assembly or C support could not be added back to the calculator.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Omni |first=Dream of |date=2020-05-20 |title=CodeWalrus - WARNING: Do NOT upgrade your TI-84 Plus CE to OS 5.5 and higher. It blocks ASM! - Page 3 |url=https://codewalr.us/ |access-date=2025-09-02 |website=CodeWalrus |language=en-US |archive-date=2025-09-12  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250912153610/https://codewalr.us/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

An exploit (commonly considered a jailbreak, despite not modifying firmware) called ''arTIfiCE'', was released four months later; it restored the ability to run assembly and C code.<ref>{{Cite web |title=CE jailbreak allows ASM programs to work again! - ticalc.org |url=https://www.ticalc.org/archives/news/articles/14/149/149365.html |access-date=2022-01-08 |website=www.ticalc.org |archive-date=2022-03-16  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220316131536/https://www.ticalc.org/archives/news/articles/14/149/149365.html |url-status=live }}</ref> The arTIfiCE exploit was patched in OS 5.8.3.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Update anti-arTIfiCE 83PCE/84+CE 5.8.3 & 82 Adv Python 5.6.5 |url=https://tiplanet.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=41&t=27020&lang=en |access-date=2025-06-13 |website=tiplanet.org |archive-date=2025-06-13  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250613183521/https://tiplanet.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=41&t=27020&lang=en |url-status=live }}</ref> However, this exploit came back within the span of a couple months after the patch with the release of arTIfiCE v2.0, restoring assembly support for the CE models, until it was patched again in OS 5.8.5.<ref>{{Cite web |title=OS TI-84 Plus CE (v. 5.8.5) |url=https://tiplanet.org/forum/archives_voir.php?id=5156448 |access-date=2026-04-17 |website=tiplanet.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=arTIfiCE v2 : ASM for 83/84 CE 5.8.3 & 82 Adv. Python 5.6.5 |url=https://tiplanet.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=41&t=27115&lang=en |access-date=2025-08-27 |website=tiplanet.org}}</ref> This does not affect the monochrome or CSE variants of the TI-84 Plus, whose last firmware updates were in 2011 and 2014 respectively.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TI-84 Plus, TI-84 Plus Silver Edition software, OS updates and apps - Texas Instruments - US and Canada |url=https://education.ti.com/en/software/search/ti-84-plus-family-ti-83-plus-family#!view=handheld-operating-system |access-date=2026-08-24 |website=education.ti.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=TI-84 Plus C Silver Edition software, OS updates and apps - Texas Instruments - US and Canada |url=https://education.ti.com/en/software/search/ti-84-plus-c-silver-edition#!view=handheld-operating-system |access-date=2026-08-24 |website=education.ti.com}}</ref>

The TI-84 Plus CE(-T) Python Edition supports using [[CircuitPython]], a Python 3 variant, developed by [[Adafruit]]. On the latest versions of the python edition models, there are 7 modules. These modules are: ''math'', ''random'', ''time'', and 4 custom modules from TI named: ''ti_system'', ''ti_plotlib'', ''ti_hub'', and ''ti_rover'', which are used for controlling the calculator, software, or other external devices made by TI. <ref>{{Cite web |title=[Fns] Menus, Modules and Add-On Modules |url=https://education.ti.com/html/eguides/graphing/84PlusCEPy/EN/content/eg_pythonappprog/m_pyentry/m_menus.HTML#Module |access-date=2026-08-24 |website=education.ti.com}}</ref>

==Technical specifications==
* '''[[Central processing unit|CPU]]:''' [[Zilog eZ80]] – 48&nbsp;MHz
* '''[[Flash ROM]]:''' 4.0MB, 3.0MB user-accessible
* '''[[Random-access memory|RAM]]:''' 154&nbsp;KB user-accessible out of 256&nbsp;KB total 
* '''[[Electronic visual display|Display]]:'''
** Text: -16-×|8| characters (normal font)
** Graphics:
*** Plus C/CE: 320 × 240-pixel screen, 140 DPI, 16-bit color. Drawing pixel range: 0-164 × 0–264.
* '''[[USB]]:''' USB Mini-AB
* '''[[Electrical power|Power]]:'''
** Rechargeable [[lithium-ion battery]]
* '''Integrated [[programming language]]s:''' [[TI-BASIC]] and [[machine code]]. [[Assembly language|Assembly]] requires a [[computer]] with an [[Zilog eZ80|eZ80]] assembler or an on-calc assembler. Includes [[Python (programming language)|Python]] for the Python edition models.

== TI-Connect CE ==
Texas Instruments produces TI-Connect CE, which is compatible with all variants of the TI-84 Plus CE. It supports installing programs, loading bundles of files, multi-device syncing and exam mode deployment, along with the ability to send [[Operating system|OS]] updates to multiple calculators at the same time, and a built-in IDE for [[TI-BASIC 83|TI-BASIC]] [[Programming language|programming]].
